parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters, one per logical submit. A repeated key with the same request returns the stored response of the first call when that response is final (24 hours, header Idempotency-Replayed: true); with another stored request it is 409 idempotency-key-reused. A refusal that a retry could pass (the RETRYABLE problem types of the API description) and a 5xx are not stored: the key is released, the retry under the same key executes again, and a different body under a released key is a new request.
